questions.question: What rights do transgender persons have in India?
triggers: what rights do transgender persons have in india
what rights do trans people have
questions.answer: The Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019 bans discrimination in education, jobs, healthcare, housing and public services. The NALSA judgment (2014) also recognised the right to self-identify one's gender.

questions.question: How do I get a Transgender Certificate / ID?
triggers: how do i get a transgender certificate
how do i get a transgender certificate id
how do i get a tg certificate
questions.answer: Apply on the National Portal for Transgender Persons (transgender.dosje.gov.in). The District Magistrate issues a Certificate of Identity, which you can use to update documents like Aadhaar and PAN.

questions.question: What can I do if I face discrimination at work?
triggers: what can i do if i face discrimination at work
fired from job for being trans
questions.answer: Every establishment must have a Complaint Officer, so report to them in writing first. If nothing happens, approach the police or the courts. Keep emails, messages and witness details as proof.

questions.question: How do I report discrimination or violence?
triggers: how do i report discrimination or violence
questions.answer: Use the Report Discrimination tab here, or file an FIR at the nearest police station. In an emergency, call 112.

questions.question: Where can I get free legal help?
triggers: where can i get free legal help
questions.answer: Call NALSA's free legal aid helpline 15100, or contact your District Legal Services Authority (DLSA).

questions.question: Is there shelter or housing support?
triggers: is there shelter or housing support
questions.answer: Yes. Under Section 12 of the Transgender Persons Act 2019, arbitrary eviction is unlawful. Garima Greh shelters under the SMILE scheme offer food, shelter and support. Check the Housing & Shelters topic to find one near you.

questions.question: Is there health insurance for transgender persons?
triggers: is there health insurance for transgender persons
questions.answer: Yes. Ayushman Bharat TG Plus covers transgender persons, including gender-affirming care. PM-JAY gives up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for eligible families.

questions.question: Tell me about HRT.
questions.answer: HRT should only be started under a qualified doctor, such as an endocrinologist, after proper tests. Please do not self-medicate or follow dosages from the internet. Ayushman Bharat TG Plus also covers gender-affirming care.

questions.question: What government schemes are available?
questions.answer: The SMILE scheme includes scholarships, skill training, livelihood support and Garima Greh shelters. Open the Schemes & Grants topic for the full list.

questions.question: What does transgender mean?
questions.answer: Transgender describes a person whose gender identity differs from the sex assigned to them at birth. In India, the Transgender Persons Act, 2019 and NALSA judgment (2014) protect the right to self-identify one's gender without discrimination.
